fonts.display: 'MonaSans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'paradigm-pro', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Espresso Bark
palette.role: Primary text, navigation background, structural borders — a warm near-black that anchors every screen without the harshness of pure #000000

palette.name: Terracotta Ember
palette.role: Primary action borders, active nav state, decorative accents — rationed to moments of intent, never used as a large surface fill

palette.name: Iris Ink
palette.role: Decorative display headings, logo monogram stroke — a vivid violet that breaks the warm palette for brand-voice headlines only

palette.name: Honey Parchment
palette.role: Subtle highlight washes, eyebrow label backgrounds, warm text tint — a muted yellow that warms the cream canvas without competing with terracotta

palette.name: Warm Linen
palette.role: Page canvas, content section backgrounds — the dominant surface, never pure white, always slightly cream

palette.name: Ash Mist
palette.role: Hairline borders, dividers, card edges — the most-used color on the site (1,300+ occurrences), creates the cool rule-lines that structure every layout

palette.name: Blush Cream
palette.role: Warm tinted surface for hover states and soft callout blocks — a peach wash that warms the cream canvas

palette.name: Lilac Mist
palette.role: Cool surface accent for secondary panels — a lavender-tinted gray that introduces gentle contrast against the warm cream

palette.name: Carbon
palette.role: True black used sparingly for image fills and footer text — Espresso Bark handles all structural dark needs
